purpose: Teach: マリオ/マーティン/スティーブン/コリン/ティム/アレックス/ニコラ/アーサー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスーパーマリオのゲームを買って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to buy you a Super Mario game.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Slight lift of pleasure in sharing good news. Steady pace, like she's watching his face for the reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとマーティン・ルーサー・キングの絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a picture book about Martin Luther King Jr.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Words tumble out with genuine excitement. Quick pace. Seeking her approval or wonder at what he discovered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスティーブン・スピルバーグ監督の映画を観て下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to watch a Spielberg film with you.
lines.style: Same warm, reflective tone as before. Gentle patience. A slight pause before the key word, like she's savoring the gift she gets to announce.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとコリン・パウエルの伝記読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a biography of Colin Powell together.
lines.style: Still bright, still eager. Slight emphasis on 'together' — he wants her to know it was shared time, not just learning.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがティム・バートン監督のアニメを観せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed you a Tim Burton animation.
lines.style: Consistent warmth. Softer this time, almost wistful. Like she's moved by how carefully his father chooses these moments.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとアレックス・ライダー、つまり児童書のヒーローの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at a picture book of Alex Rider — you know, the boy hero from those stories.
lines.style: Eager and specific. He's explaining because he wants her to understand why it matters. Quick breath between clauses. Genuine pride in sharing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがニコラ・テスラの伝記を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is reading a biography of Nikola Tesla.
lines.style: Gentle admiration in the voice. Slightly hushed, like she's witnessing something between him and his father. Almost reverent about the depth of their connection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとアーサー王伝説の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read a picture book about King Arthur.
lines.style: Bright and warm, like before, but with a satisfied close. Slight warmth at the end, like he's at peace with all these moments stacked together.
